app.name: Argos APM
app.tagline: Application performance monitoring for Java services

status.preRelease: Pre-release build. Not for production use.

term.apdexDescription: Share of satisfied requests: within the threshold T counts fully, within 4T half

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not match any page. Check the link or go to the start page.

tooltip.up: The agent is connected and sends heartbeats.
tooltip.stale: No heartbeat for 60 s or more.
tooltip.down: No heartbeat for 180 s or more, or 5 minutes since the agent shut down.

empty.title: No data in the selected range.
empty.description: Widen the time range or check the filters and the kind.
empty.excluded_one: {{count, number}} request was excluded in this range
empty.excluded_other: {{count, number}} requests were excluded in this range

error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this. Ask an administrator for a role.
error.notFound: Not found. It may be outside the retention period, or the link may be wrong.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
error.rateLimitedNow: Too many requests. You can try again now.
error.timeout: The query took too long. Narrow the time range and try again.
error.unavailable: Storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
error.starting: The server is starting. Try again in a moment.
error.rangeInvalid: The time range is not valid. Choose another range.
error.limitExceeded: The result exceeds a limit. Narrow the time range or add filters.
error.filterInvalid: A filter cannot be applied. Check or clear the filters.
error.unsupportedSort: This sort order is not supported. Sort by another column.
error.badRequest: The request was not valid. Check the time range and the filters.
error.server: The server could not complete the request. Try again; if it keeps failing, report the request ID.

loading.label: Loading
loading.slow: Still loading… Narrow the time range to make it faster.

partial.samplingNoCount: Showing a sample of the data
partial.truncated: Only the first {{shown}} results are shown. Narrow the range or add filters.
partial.truncatedNoCount: The result was cut at the limit. Narrow the range or add filters.
partial.retentionExceeded: Raw data retention period exceeded: aggregated data is shown.

filterChips.label: Applied filters
filterChips.tooLong: The value is too long. Filter values can have at most 1,024 bytes (UTF-8).

kind.label: Transaction kind
kind.batchUnavailable: This application has no batch transactions.

timeRange.label: Time range
timeRange.timeZone: Times are in your browser time zone ({{offset}}).
timeRange.invalid: The start must be before the end.
timeRange.liveUnavailable: This page has no live mode.

dataTable.cellFocus: Value column: {{column}}. Left and Right arrows change it, Shift+F10 opens the value actions.
dataTable.valueTooLongForFilter: This value is longer than 1,024 bytes (UTF-8) and cannot be used as a filter.

filter.rangeInvalid: Enter numbers with the minimum not above the maximum.
filter.tooLong: The text is too long. Filter values can have at most 1,024 bytes (UTF-8).

chart.legendHint: Click to show or hide. Shift+click to show only this series.
